# assets/

This directory holds the **embedded libonnxruntime archives** that are bundled
into the axon binary at build time when using the `onnx` build tag.

## Contents (generated by build script)

| File | Platform |
|------|----------|
| `onnxruntime-osx-arm64-1.21.0.tgz` | macOS Apple Silicon |
| `onnxruntime-osx-x86_64-1.21.0.tgz` | macOS Intel |
| `onnxruntime-linux-x64-1.21.0.tgz` | Linux x86_64 |
| `onnxruntime-linux-aarch64-1.21.0.tgz` | Linux ARM64 |

## How files get here

Run:
```bash
./scripts/build.sh --onnx
```

The script automatically downloads the correct archive for your current
platform before invoking `go build`. CI workflows download all platforms
for cross-platform release builds.

**Do NOT commit `.tgz` files** — they are generated artifacts (~10MB each).
They are listed in `.gitignore`.
